title: AYE SHAHEEDE KARBALA FATIMA ZEHRA KE PISAR ASRE AASHOOR KATA DASHTE BALA ME TERA SAR
body:
Baagqi jis tarha se ab Naam Khuda ka hai Hussain
Tu bhi zinda hai Tera naam bhi zinda hai Hussain
Tu ne jangal me bhare ghar ko lutaya hai Hussain
